summary.text: Justin Wilmeth, a Republican, has represented District 2, in north Phoenix, in the Arizona House of Representatives since 2021.

paragraphs.text: According to his legislative biography, he was appointed chairman of the new House Artificial Intelligence & Innovation Committee in 2026 and previously chaired the House Commerce Committee for two years.

Wilmeth lists his occupation as consultant and holds a bachelor's degree in Political Science, a Master of Public Administration and a Master of Arts in Global Security, all from Arizona State University.
